'''Ordo Tera Spaceport''',<ref name="CGttSWG" /> also known as simply '''Ordo Tera''', was a [[space station]]<ref name="CLNE" /> that orbited a [[planet]]<ref name="Tribe" /> in the [[Ordo Tera system]], a [[star system]] located in the [[Belasco sector]] of the greater [[Expansion Region]] and [[the Slice]]<ref name="Slice" /> portions of [[the galaxy]], falling in grid square P-11 on the [[Standard Galactic Grid]]. A [[hyperspace route]] connected it to [[Gyndine]] and [[Randon]].<ref name="CLNE" /> The station was concentric and featured two large city-like sprawling towers, one of which was topped with a [[Subspace communications antenna|communications mast]]. The sides of the station featured multiple [[hangar]]s.<ref name="Tribe" /> The station was controlled by the criminal organization [[Vanguard Axis]],<ref name="CGttSWG" /> which had a [[Axis Base|base of operations]] there. The group's activities included the trafficking of [[Slavery|enslaved]] individuals, such as the [[Padawan]] [[Wookiee]] [[Gungi]].<ref name="Tribe" />
